name: Dakotaland Woodwork & Cabinets LLC.
old_description: Introducing a great line of high quality cabinets, countertops, and furniture for commercial and residential purposes. Our cabinets are versatile, sanitary, well designed and constructed to provide you with long lasting beauty in your space. We work with you to build a solid, reliable, and aesthetically pleasing cabinet that accents and refreshes your home or workplace.
about:
Dakotaland Woodwork & Cabinets LLC operates from Raymond, South Dakota. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. It presents a line of high-quality cabinets, countertops, and furniture designed for versatility and sanitation in both home and workplace settings.

The shop produces custom cabinets, countertops, and furniture for both residential and commercial projects. Its core offering is Thermofoil cabinet doors built on a medium-density fiberboard core that is heat-clad with laminate finishes, a hybrid the company says combines the look of wood with added durability. The line also includes painted and solid-wood doors and drawers, with styles ranging from European frameless to traditional face-frame construction. The company’s website highlights a wide selection of cabinet styles.

Customers include homeowners and commercial contractors; a testimonial on the company’s site notes a relationship spanning more than ten years. The firm serves the broader South Dakota region with no specific industry verticals called out beyond general residential and commercial interiors.

Dakotaland emphasizes that its cabinets are versatile, sanitary, and built for long-lasting beauty, positioning the Thermofoil hybrid as a durable alternative to solid wood. The company says it works directly with clients to deliver solid, reliable, and aesthetically pleasing results, and markets its output as “custom built in South Dakota.”
